intended_use: Research prototype for offline, educational exploration of automated lemon-leaf condition classification. Intended for use on a single leaf photographed on a plain white sheet under even lighting, on Android devices in airplane mode. Results should be interpreted by a researcher or student, not by a farmer for treatment decisions.
out_of_scope_use: Field-ready disease diagnosis or treatment recommendation
Use on non-lemon citrus species without revalidation
Use on images with natural backgrounds (the model was trained on near-white backgrounds and fails on other backgrounds)
Use as a substitute for laboratory testing (HLB is only confirmed by PCR or qPCR)

training_data_summary.preprocessing: PIL BICUBIC resize to 384x384, then F.interpolate(bilinear, antialias=True) to 320x320, normalised with ImageNet mean/std
training_data_summary.fold_assignment: Group-aware 5-fold (grouped by plant_id to prevent leakage)

deployed_model_metrics.uncertainty_note: HLB recall (87.9%) is based on only 33 test images. The Wilson 95% confidence interval for this proportion is approximately [72.7%, 95.2%]. Results should be interpreted with this wide uncertainty in mind.

external_validation_failure.summary: The model FAILED external validation on datasets from different sources. Accuracy on matched classes ranged from 0.47 to 0.68. Healthy leaves were frequently misclassified as HLB.
external_validation_failure.key_failure: Healthy leaves often predicted as HLB on external data

domain_shift_evidence.description: Internal and external images are trivially separable by simple colour statistics. The model appears to rely on background cues rather than leaf pathology.

abstention_thresholds.status: DERIVED from OOF logits of all 5 convnext_tiny@320 folds (1541 predictions)
abstention_thresholds.derivation_source: OOF logits from all 5 convnext_tiny@320 fold models (1541 out-of-fold predictions)
abstention_thresholds.rationale: All 5 models share the same architecture, hyperparameters, and seed. The uncertainty distribution is architecture-dependent, not fold-specific. Per-fold breakdown shows consistent selective accuracy (96.3%-97.7%) and coverage (93.3%-97.7%).
abstention_thresholds.note: Temperature scaling was NOT applied because it was fitted on in-distribution data and made calibration worse on external data.
abstention_thresholds.abstention_rule: Abstain if max softmax < tau OR (top1 - top2) < delta. Show: Uncertain, please retake or consult an expert.

test_set_abstention_only_stress.note: OOF selective accuracy (97.03%) is optimistic; test-set figures are the cleaner estimate.

external_set_abstention_only_stress.note: External set has 4 of 5 classes. Abstention does not fix the domain-shift problem. Healthy leaves are still catastrophically misclassified (1.5% sel_acc on accepted healthy images). The quality gate (100% external rejection by border brightness) is the primary protection.

capture_quality_thresholds.status: DERIVED from training images of folds 0,1,3,4 (1245 images, NOT fold 2 validation, NOT test)
capture_quality_thresholds.sharpness_definition: Variance of Laplacian of grayscale image. Reject if below threshold (too blurry).
capture_quality_thresholds.exposure_definition: Mean pixel brightness (0-1 scale). Reject if outside range (too dark or too bright).
capture_quality_thresholds.border_brightness_definition: Mean brightness of border pixels (outer 5% on each side). Reject if below threshold (background not white enough).
capture_quality_thresholds.saturation_definition: Mean HSV saturation (0-1 scale). Reject if outside range (monochrome or oversaturated).
capture_quality_thresholds.percentiles_used: 1st percentile for lower bounds, 99th percentile for upper bounds
capture_quality_thresholds.note: If a check fails, the app shows a retake message and does not classify.

stress_test.note: 100% of external images rejected by quality gate (border brightness is the main filter). This is expected: external images have natural backgrounds while training images have near-white backgrounds.

calibration_note: Raw softmax probabilities are shown without temperature scaling. Temperature scaling was fitted on in-distribution (training-domain) data and made calibration WORSE on external data. The displayed confidence is therefore not a calibrated probability of correctness under different lighting or backgrounds. The app displays: 'Confidence is not a probability of correctness under different lighting or backgrounds.'

preprocessing.phone_pipeline: centre-crop to square, resize to 512 (bicubic), resize to 384 (bicubic), resize to 320 (bilinear with antialias), normalise with exported mean/std
preprocessing.antialias_note: Android's default scaling is NOT equivalent to torch's F.interpolate(antialias=True). The antialiased resize must be implemented explicitly on device.
preprocessing.large_photo_downscale: stepwise halving (F.interpolate area) then bicubic to 512

large_photo_test_result.note: The 98.6% top-1 agreement is for upsampled-then-downsampled images vs the reference pipeline (384x320). These differ by construction; some mismatches are expected. The 99% rule applies to same-resolution parity (Dart vs Python on the same 384x384 input).

inference.runtime: ONNX Runtime Android (via Flutter onnxruntime package 1.4.1)
inference.runtime_bundled_ort_native: ~1.17.x (pre-built jniLibs; NOT ORT 1.22.0 — see decisions.md D23)
inference.runtime_rationale: Full package (not the mobile/reduced build) to guarantee all operators are supported, including LayerNormalization (23 nodes), Erf/GELU (18 nodes), and grouped Conv (depthwise).

fp16.deployment_note: Not deployed in the Android app; FP32 is the configured runtime model.

int8.rejection_reason: INT8 static quantization hurts ConvNeXt LayerNorm layers (rank-1 weights cannot be per-channel quantized). 5.9-point macro-F1 drop, only 92.6% top-1 agreement.

latency_pc_cpu.note: PC CPU single-threaded. On-device latency will be measured in Stage 5.

licences.dataset: Kaggle lemon-leaf-dataset by mdnaimulhasanemon (see dataset page for licence)

ensemble_vs_deployed.note: The 95.69% figure belongs to the 30-model ensemble, NOT to the model on the phone. The deployed single model achieves 95.22%. The 95.69% value must NOT appear in the app UI.
